_doc: Language rules, all deterministic (no LLM). A source's language comes from config/sources.csv (column language); only when a source is unknown, or has none, is the text itself inspected. A story is written in Turkish only when EVERY source covering it is Turkish; a mixed or English cluster is English. This file is the one place for that rule.

detection._doc: Fallback for unknown sources. Turkish when the text has at least one Turkish-only letter AND one common Turkish word, or at least min_word_hits common Turkish words.
